{{Quote|The blood must flow.|Darth Harkon|<ref name="Hemophilic Slash">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=item|Hemophilic Slash|[[Sabacc Sav]] on [[Carrick Station]] and [[Morro the Reaper]] on [[Vaiken Spacedock]]}}</ref>}}
'''Darth Harkon''' was an individual<ref name="Hemophilic Slash" /> affiliated with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Sith" /> They claimed that the blood must flow.<ref name="Hemophilic Slash" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Harkon was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', a [[2019]] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the game, they are mentioned in the description for the "Hemophilic Slash" Tactical item as the author of a quote provided in it.<ref name="Hemophilic Slash" />
